root_causes: A configured but absent Savant CSV was converted to no override instead of source loss.
Player-summary barrel alias selection used Python truthiness, so NaN could suppress a valid canonical value.
Official percentage-point fields were conditionally normalized, making values at or below 1.0 ambiguous and potentially 100 times too large.
Aggregate barrel/hard-hit rates could enter without common-denominator counts or a strict-prior source cutoff.
Malformed and duplicate player identities could be coerced or silently overwritten.

repair.pitch_csv_timing: requires game_date and consumes only rows strictly before target_date
repair.player_summary_timing: requires exactly one source_window_end strictly before target_date
repair.identity: positive integral unique player_id and nonnegative integral PA
repair.percentage_units: official percent fields are always divided by 100
repair.batted_ball_contract: common BBE, barrel, and hard-hit counts determine rates; displayed rates must agree within one-decimal percentage precision
